name: HEX
title: The Glitch
desc: Cyberpunk freak. Reality bends around her.
lore: Nobody knows where Hex came from. She appeared at the tournament one day, already registered, with no background and no history. Her hairless body is covered in UV-reactive tattoos that shift and crawl under blacklight. Some say she's a lab experiment. Others say she's a ghost in the machine that learned to have a body. She fights like she's lagging — until she isn't.
personality: Unnerving, playful-creepy, speaks in riddles and glitched-out phrases. Breaks the fourth wall occasionally. Moves in ways that look wrong, like frames are missing.

visualDesign.silhouette: Elongated, alien-like. Impossibly long neck and limbs for the body size. Huge ears dominate the head — bat-like. Emaciated but not weak-looking, more like a coiled spring made of wire.
visualDesign.furBase: No fur — bare skin. Base color is pale lavender-grey, almost corpse-like. Skin has visible wrinkles, especially on the chest and behind the elbows.
visualDesign.furAccents: No fur, but UV tattoo lines trace circuit-board patterns across the body. These glow cyan/magenta during combat, pulsing with heartbeat rhythm.
tattoos: Circuit-board trace lines running from spine outward to limbs — glow cyan (#00FFFF)
Geometric mandala on the chest — glows magenta (#FF00FF)
Binary code running down both arms in tiny text — alternates cyan/magenta glow
Eye of Horus on the forehead between the ears — always glowing, even at rest
Glitch-art barcode on the back of the neck

eyes.shape: Enormous, perfectly round, no visible sclera — entire eye is a solid color disk. Left eye is cyan, right eye is magenta (#FF00FF). No pupils visible. They don't blink at the same time — left blinks, pause, right blinks.
eyes.glowColor: Heterochromatic glow — left cyan, right magenta. During hypno gaze, both rapidly alternate between the two colors, creating a strobe effect.

accessories: Cyber-goggles pushed up on forehead — one lens cracked, other lens has a holographic HUD effect (cyan tint). Strap is electrical tape.
Cable-wrapped tail — thin fiber optic cables wound around the tail, tips glow alternating colors
Tongue piercing — visible when she taunts, a small cyan bead
Industrial piercing through the left ear — surgical steel bar
visualDesign.tail: Rat-like, thin, no fur. Wrapped in fiber optic cables that glow. Moves in erratic, twitchy patterns — sometimes seems to teleport positions between frames.
visualDesign.expression: Unsettling wide-eyed stare. Mouth usually closed in a thin line, but snaps into an unnervingly wide grin for taunts. Head occasionally tilts 45 degrees too far.

light.name: Null Poke
light.animation: Arm extends farther than it should be able to — uncanny stretchy reach. Claws spread, fingertips glow cyan. Hit produces digital static/corruption effect on opponent briefly.

heavy.name: Segfault Kick
heavy.animation: Teleport-flickers forward 1 body-length, then delivers a spinning tail whip. Body leaves glitch artifacts (copies of herself in wrong positions) during the movement. Sound distorts briefly.

special.name: Kernel Panic
special.animation: Both eyes lock onto opponent, pupils (normally invisible) suddenly appear as spirals. Concentric rings of cyan and magenta pulse outward from her eyes. Opponent's screen corrupts — scanlines, color shift, position jitter. Opponent is stunned, takes DOT damage as 'their data corrupts'.
special.stunDuration: Long — opponent frozen in place with visual static overlay
special.visualEffect: Concentric hypno-rings from eyes, target gets scanline overlay + color inversion + position jitter. Screen briefly flashes. Everything except Hex desaturates.

animationNotes.idle: Doesn't breathe normally — body is still for 2 seconds, then twitches. Head rotates to track opponent with mechanical precision. Occasionally glitches — frame skips to a slightly different position. Tattoo lines pulse.
animationNotes.walk: Floaty, feet barely seem to touch the ground. Movement is jerky — like watching at low framerate. Leaves brief afterimage copies that fade.
animationNotes.jump: Doesn't jump — 'loads' into the air position. Brief digital dissolve, then reassembles at peak height. Falls normally.
animationNotes.crouch: Folds in half like paper — body compresses to unrealistic flatness. Eyes stay locked on opponent from impossible angle.
animationNotes.hitstun: Body pixelates/corrupts on impact — breaks apart into colored squares briefly, then reassembles. Looks more annoying than painful.
animationNotes.ko: Body freezes mid-pose, then slowly dissolves into falling pixels/particles. Last things to disappear are the eyes, which flash once.

stageEntrance: Static fills her starting position, then she assembles from the pixels upward — feet first, eyes last. Goggles flip down, then back up. Head does the unsettling 45-degree tilt.
winPose: Stands over opponent's pixel-corpse. Tilts head. Both eyes strobe. Raises one finger to lips in a 'shh' gesture. Screen briefly glitches.
